note: Drive east on 1800/1900 North from Logan to the canyon mouth, then up the canyon road a little over a mile; park at campsite 7, directly in front of Devil's Cave where most routes are. Inverted Stairway is across the road a short way up.

Winter ice access: the canyon road is unpaved and only the bottom half mile is plowed. Park at the lot half a mile up, which fills with snowmobile trailers on weekends; the climbs are near an old limestone quarry about 2.25 miles beyond.
